blocks.text: Vedpriya Dongre is a Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at IET, Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya (DAVV), Indore. She holds an M.Tech in Software Engineering and is currently pursuing her Ph.D., with over 10 years of teaching experience. Her research interests include Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Software Engineering. Her current research focuses on social media text and image classification and fake news detection.
